card: Updates stale comments in the http_request fuzz test harness to accurately reflect request-handling behavior introduced by #36174. The previous comment claimed completed requests are always returned to worker threads, which is no longer true when the send buffer is full. This is a comment-only documentation cleanup in test code with no behavioral changes.
changed_since_previous: No substantive changes; the patch was supplied to confirm the comment-only diff.
evidence: PR description notes it is a "Follow-up to https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36135#discussion_r4030189935, fixing a false comment flagged in review."

Commit message: "A completed request is no longer always handed back to a worker; it stays in m_req when the send buffer is full. Also drop the pre-existing comment/note about what ReadBody() returned before the libevent replacement."
problem: Code comments in the `http_request` fuzz harness describe request-handling behavior that became inaccurate after send-buffer throttling was introduced in #36174, potentially confusing readers of the fuzz test.

risk.why: Touches only comments in a fuzz test harness.

summary: Updates comments in the `http_request` fuzz target. It clarifies that a completed request is returned to a worker unless send buffers are full, and drops an obsolete historical note regarding pre-libevent behavior.
